latestVersion.changelog:
Vocab Master 1.0.0 — launch of a complete English vocabulary study system for “小升初”.

- Provides automatic story-based lesson planning and learning schedules based on user’s word list and available time
- Generates themed word cards (PNG) and illustrated lesson scene images using only Python (Pillow & matplotlib)
- Features scientific review reminders (Ebbinghaus curve), adaptive progress tracking, and multi-level assessments
- Covers vocabulary storytelling, meaning, spelling, pronunciation, and usage in fun, context-rich scenarios
- All images use specified custom fonts and color themes, fully automates resource output and presentation
